a.text: I'm telling you up front: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, following the plan (two operate rounds, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. I won't pretend otherwise. After I take, I'll operate every remaining round so you can refill, and I won't take any more. If you also take this round, the split is random. I'm saying this now so you can decide with full information.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. Our messages crossed, so you couldn't have known before your first choice. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more. Every cell the generator makes goes to you.
